correction.finding: Scene S005 depicts an honor guard firing a three-volley rifle salute in close proximity to attendees. If practical firearms or blanks are utilized on set, CSATF Safety Bulletin #1 specifies that production must conduct a safety meeting with all involved personnel including an on-site walk-through or dry run before any firearm is used, and that protective shields, eye and hearing protection, or other appropriate personal protective equipment shall be issued and utilized by all personnel in close proximity or directly in the line of fire.

dropped.finding: Scene S005 depicts a military honor guard of three veterans firing a three-volley blank rifle salute in close proximity to attendees, including a 10-year-old child (Sam) who clamps his hands over his ears and a dog (Barnacle) tied to a fence. Under CSATF Safety Bulletin #1, all firearms capable of discharging blanks must be maintained and controlled exclusively by a licensed Property Master or certified Armorer. Production must hold a mandatory on-site safety meeting and walk-through prior to firing. Mandatory hearing protection (PPE) and acoustic safety buffer zones must be established for cast and crew in the line of fire, particularly to safeguard the minor performer and animal from concussive sound and muzzle discharge hazards. Staging may alternately utilize quarter-load blanks, electronic non-firing replicas, or post-production sound/VFX enhancement. Costs vary by armorer daily rate, prop rentals, and location logistics.
